project.name: Hello Butler — Current Execution Workflows
project.description: Source-based workflow model of fesnguyen/hello-butler, main at commit 091f1ddc4a4fcd70d3ee093d3525beb629fe6ac4. Covers verified Android event scheduling, audio continuation, synchronization, Butler requests, and nightly preparation. Ordinary non-audio daily events are not automatically executed by the current DailyEventScheduler. This is a current-state model, not a proposed unified scheduler.

workflows.name: Daily Event Scheduling
workflows.description: Schedules eligible spoken events and reminders using AlarmManager or WorkManager. Ordinary non-audio events do not receive an execution alarm.

nodes.title: Schedule daily event
nodes.description: A daily event is submitted to the scheduler.
nodes.notes: This is the current event scheduling entry point. It does not schedule every DailyEventEntity.

file.description: Daily event alarm registration and cancellation.

constructorParameters.name: context
constructorParameters.description: Android context used to access AlarmManager and schedule background work.

function.name: schedule

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Daily event to evaluate and schedule.

function.description: Validates scheduling eligibility and registers or cancels execution.

calls.name: cancel
calls.description: Cancels the alarm, worker, and deferred notification.

nodes.title: Eligible for scheduling?
nodes.description: Requires a valid future or due trigger, planned status, nonempty spoken content, no playback attempt, and either speakAloud=true or eventType=reminder.
nodes.notes: The code rejects events when triggerAt is null, status is not planned, both speakAloud is false and type is not reminder, all text fields are blank, or playbackAttemptedAt is not null.

function.name: schedule
function.description: Contains the eligibility guard before scheduling.

nodes.title: Cancel existing scheduling
nodes.description: Removes the existing alarm, execution worker, and deferred speech notification.
nodes.notes: An ordinary non-audio event follows this branch. This does not delete the event from the database.

function.name: cancel
function.description: Cancels Android alarm, worker, and notification.

nodes.title: Trigger already due?
nodes.description: Checks whether triggerAt is less than or equal to the current timestamp.
nodes.notes: Past or due events use a separate branch. Only events passing isDueForSpeech are enqueued immediately.

function.name: schedule
function.description: Checks the calculated trigger against current time.

calls.name: isDueForSpeech
calls.description: Checks whether an event is due for speech.

nodes.title: Enqueue due execution
nodes.description: Uses WorkManager to offer playback for an event already due.
nodes.notes: Only taken if isDueForSpeech returns true.

function.name: enqueue

parameters.name: delayMillis
parameters.description: Execution delay, zero for immediate work.

function.description: Enqueues a uniquely named execution worker.

nodes.title: Exact alarms allowed?
nodes.description: Checks Android version and exact-alarm permission.
nodes.notes: On Android versions before S, exact scheduling is treated as allowed. Otherwise canScheduleExactAlarms is checked.

function.name: schedule
function.description: Selects exact alarm or WorkManager fallback.

nodes.title: Register exact alarm
nodes.description: Calls AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle with event identity, version, and trigger timestamp.
nodes.notes: If registration throws, the scheduler enqueues the WorkManager fallback.

function.name: alarmPendingIntent
function.description: Creates a broadcast PendingIntent targeting DailyEventAlarmReceiver.

nodes.title: Schedule WorkManager fallback
nodes.description: Schedules a delayed DailyEventExecutionWorker when exact alarms are unavailable or registration fails.
nodes.notes: A delayed worker does not directly start a foreground playback service. It offers a local Listen action.

function.name: enqueue

parameters.name: delayMillis
parameters.description: Remaining delay until the event trigger.

function.description: Registers a delayed worker.

nodes.title: Alarm fires
nodes.description: Android delivers the scheduled broadcast.
nodes.notes: The receiver loads the current event and validates both event version and expected trigger.

function.name: onReceive

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: Broadcast containing event identity and expected version and trigger.

function.description: Validates and handles a scheduled event alarm.

calls.name: offerEventPlayback
calls.description: Attempts to publish a Listen notification.

nodes.title: Event still valid and due?
nodes.description: Checks isDueForSpeech and matchesAlarm against the current database event.
nodes.notes: Stale, cancelled, changed, or otherwise ineligible alarms return without playback.

function.name: matchesAlarm
function.description: Rejects stale alarms.

nodes.title: Ignore stale alarm
nodes.description: Execution stops without playback.
nodes.notes: The receiver returns when the event is absent, ineligible, or mismatched.

nodes.title: Offer notification and consider audio
nodes.description: Attempts a deferred Listen notification. If sound settings allow automatic playback, starts ButlerAudioPlaybackService. Otherwise playback is not automatically started.
nodes.notes: If the playback offer fails, an execution worker is enqueued. IllegalStateException and SecurityException from starting playback also enqueue a worker.

function.name: onReceive
function.description: Offers event playback and conditionally launches audio.

nodes.title: Event execution handed off
nodes.description: Notification offering or audio playback proceeds through its respective component.
nodes.notes: This is a handoff, not a guarantee that audio plays or a notification is displayed.

useCases.name: Ordinary non-audio event
useCases.description: A planned event has a valid time but is neither spoken nor a reminder.
useCases.notes: The scheduler cancels any existing execution and returns. No event-time notification is scheduled by this function.

useCases.name: Future spoken event
useCases.description: A planned event requests speech and exact alarms are available.
useCases.notes: Registers an exact alarm for the future trigger.

useCases.name: Reminder without speakAloud
useCases.description: A reminder qualifies for scheduling even if speakAloud is false.
useCases.notes: The reminder event type independently satisfies the scheduling condition.

useCases.name: Exact alarm permission unavailable
useCases.description: An eligible future event falls back to WorkManager.
useCases.notes: The worker offers a Listen notification rather than directly launching background foreground-service playback.

workflows.name: Audio Workflow Scheduling and Continuation
workflows.description: Schedules persisted audio execution checkpoints and resumes them through Android alarm or worker entry points.

nodes.title: Schedule audio execution
nodes.description: Receives an AudioExecution with its workflow, checkpoint, and due timestamp.
nodes.notes: AudioWorkflowScheduler is distinct from DailyEventScheduler.

function.name: schedule

parameters.name: execution
parameters.description: Audio execution containing workflow state and continuation checkpoint.

function.description: Schedules an eligible audio continuation.

nodes.title: Can execution continue?
nodes.description: Checks execution.canContinue(next, dueAt).
nodes.notes: If the check fails, schedule returns without registering continuation work.

function.name: schedule
function.description: Rejects non-continuable executions.

nodes.title: No continuation scheduled
nodes.description: The execution is not scheduled.
nodes.notes: Early return from schedule.

nodes.title: Persist and register continuation
nodes.description: Transitions execution state and registers unique WorkManager continuation work, with alarm handling as implemented by the scheduler.
nodes.notes: The scheduler retains execution-specific identity for cancellation and continuation.

function.name: schedule
function.description: Schedules continuation using persisted execution state.

nodes.title: Audio continuation fires
nodes.description: A scheduled audio continuation is handled by AudioContinuationReceiver or AudioContinuationWorker.
nodes.notes: The receiver and worker are separate Android entry points. Both operate on persisted audio execution identity and checkpoint state.

function.name: onReceive
function.description: Handles scheduled audio continuation.

nodes.title: Resume playback service
nodes.description: Requests the single ButlerAudioPlaybackService owner to resume the saved execution.
nodes.notes: Playback admission and validity checks occur in the service.

function.name: resume
function.description: Starts the foreground playback service with continuation identity.

nodes.title: Validate and execute playback
nodes.description: The service admits the request, validates current execution and event state, and runs the playback sequence.
nodes.notes: Playback may be rejected or cancelled. Starting the service does not guarantee that audio plays.

function.name: executePlayback
function.description: Executes playback through the service-owned player.

parameters.name: execution
parameters.description: Execution whose event identity is checked.

nodes.title: Playback handled
nodes.description: The service handles completion, cancellation, or rejection.
nodes.notes: The service owns playback resource cleanup.

useCases.name: Valid continuation
useCases.description: An audio execution is eligible for continuation.
useCases.notes: Registers continuation and resumes through the playback service when due.

useCases.name: Execution cannot continue
useCases.notes: schedule returns without registering new continuation work.

workflows.name: Daily Event Synchronization
workflows.description: Synchronizes local event edits and retrieves daily plan snapshots from the backend.

nodes.title: Daily sync worker starts
nodes.description: WorkManager starts a one-time or periodic synchronization.
nodes.notes: One-time work uses APPEND_OR_REPLACE. Periodic work is scheduled every six hours with KEEP. Both require network connectivity.

function.name: doWork
function.description: Runs authenticated settings and daily event synchronization.

calls.name: synchronize
calls.description: Pushes pending edits and pulls daily plans.

nodes.title: Authenticated session?
nodes.description: Checks authRepository.hasSession().
nodes.notes: Without a session, the worker returns success without synchronizing.

nodes.title: Skip sync
nodes.description: Returns Result.success without a session.
nodes.notes: No server synchronization is attempted.

nodes.title: Synchronize settings
nodes.description: Attempts user settings synchronization independently.
nodes.notes: The worker captures non-cancellation failures for retry handling.

function.name: doWork
function.description: Calls userSettingsRepository.synchronize.

nodes.title: Push and pull daily events
nodes.description: Pushes pending local edits, then pulls requested dates including today and tomorrow.
nodes.notes: The repository synchronizes distinct dates and returns the set of successfully pulled dates.

function.name: synchronize
function.description: Pushes pending edits before pulling each requested date.

calls.name: pull
calls.description: Retrieves and reconciles a daily plan.

nodes.title: Both sync operations succeeded?
nodes.description: Checks the settings and event synchronization results.
nodes.notes: Cancellation exceptions are rethrown. Other failures lead to retry.

nodes.title: Synchronization complete
nodes.description: Returns Result.success.
nodes.notes: Both operations completed successfully.

nodes.title: Retry synchronization
nodes.description: Returns Result.retry.
nodes.notes: At least one synchronization operation failed.

useCases.name: Authenticated successful sync
useCases.description: Both settings and event synchronization succeed.

useCases.name: No authenticated session
useCases.notes: The worker returns success without network synchronization.

workflows.name: Butler Text and Audio Requests
workflows.description: Queues user text or audio, uploads the request, reconciles backend results, and prepares response audio when available.

nodes.title: User submits Butler input
nodes.description: The user submits text or an audio recording.
nodes.notes: The repository supports queueText and queueAudio. Audio input is validated as Ogg/Opus.

function.name: queueText
function.description: Creates a durable text request and returns its identifier.

nodes.title: Upload queued request
nodes.description: A network-constrained worker calls ButlerRepository.upload.
nodes.notes: Work is uniquely named by request ID and uses KEEP. Failures cause retry.

function.name: upload
function.description: Uploads a durable request to the backend.

nodes.title: Backend accepts and processes request
nodes.description: The backend accepts the text or audio request and processes it through ButlerRequestService and ButlerService.
nodes.notes: The backend exposes asynchronous request acceptance and result retrieval.

function.name: process
function.description: Processes a queued Butler request.

calls.name: handle
calls.description: Validates input and invokes the Butler graph.

nodes.title: Reconcile backend result
nodes.description: The result worker retrieves request status and persists completed responses.
nodes.notes: Accepted or processing results cause retry. Completed results are reconciled locally.

function.name: reconcile
function.description: Retrieves and reconciles the backend result.

nodes.title: Response audio available and enabled?
nodes.description: Checks whether ensureAudio returns a file and whether sound settings enable responses.
nodes.notes: Audio playback also requires a recent response. The worker checks whether the Butler message was created within the previous 600 seconds.

function.name: doWork
function.description: Obtains response audio and determines whether to offer playback.

nodes.title: Reserve and offer response playback
nodes.description: Creates a BUTLER_RESPONSE AudioExecution. Foreground requests may resume playback immediately; background requests are offered through AudioWorkflowScheduler.
nodes.notes: The audio execution is reserved before playback is requested.

function.name: doWork
function.description: Prepares the response audio execution.

calls.name: offer
calls.description: Offers playback through the audio workflow notification mechanism.

nodes.title: Response reconciled
nodes.description: The response is stored; audio playback may have been requested separately.
nodes.notes: Text result completion and audio playback are distinct outcomes.

useCases.name: Text request without playback
useCases.description: A text request completes without response audio playback.
useCases.notes: The response is reconciled and displayed independently of audio.

useCases.name: Audio request with response playback
useCases.description: An audio request completes with recent response audio and playback enabled.

useCases.name: Response too old for automatic playback
useCases.description: The response is older than the recent-message threshold.
useCases.notes: The worker does not create automatic response playback for an old message.

workflows.name: Nightly Planning and Good Night Preparation
workflows.description: Schedules nightly backend preparation, including Good Night Summary and next-day planning.

nodes.title: Schedule nightly planning
nodes.description: Computes the next 22:30 local execution and checks whether a missed evening needs recovery.
nodes.notes: Uses unique WorkManager requests keyed by date. Network connectivity is required.

function.name: scheduleNext
function.description: Schedules the next nightly preparation and eligible missed preparation.

nodes.title: Nightly worker runs
nodes.description: Reads the requested summary date and checks the authenticated session.
nodes.notes: The worker schedules the next run even when no session is available.

function.name: doWork
function.description: Validates and performs nightly preparation.

nodes.title: Session and summary date valid?
nodes.description: Requires an authenticated session and a summary date equal to today or yesterday.
nodes.notes: Invalid, too-old, or future dates are skipped. The next nightly run is still scheduled.

nodes.title: Skip preparation
nodes.description: Schedules the next run and returns success.
nodes.notes: No evening preparation request is made.

nodes.title: Prepare evening and tomorrow
nodes.description: Calls DailyEventRepository.prepareEvening, which coordinates the backend evening preparation.
nodes.notes: The repository pushes pending changes before evening preparation and checks the durable prepared-date marker.

function.name: prepareEvening
function.description: Coordinates evening preparation and daily plan synchronization.

nodes.title: Backend prepares summary
nodes.description: EveningPreparationService prepares the summary using current planning context.
nodes.notes: The backend API is POST /api/planning/evening-prepare. The service uses a user planning lock.

function.name: prepare
function.description: Prepares and persists evening planning results.

nodes.title: Nightly preparation handled
nodes.description: Schedules the next nightly run and returns success, or requests retry after a non-cancellation failure.
nodes.notes: Future nightly scheduling is kept independent of retries for a failed date.

useCases.name: Normal nightly preparation
useCases.description: Authenticated user with today's valid summary date.
useCases.notes: Prepares evening context and schedules the next nightly run.

useCases.name: No authenticated session
useCases.notes: Skips preparation and schedules the next run.

useCases.name: Stale summary date
useCases.description: The requested summary date is older than yesterday.
useCases.notes: The worker skips this date instead of processing an unbounded backlog.
